QuestInfo.name: The Hard-Fought Lv. 50 Challenge!
QuestInfo.0: They say that you will receive a ring with absolute power if you reach Lv. 50...
QuestInfo.1: Reach Lv. 50 and go see Cassandra to receive one of the following items as a gift: #b#t1112427#, #t1112428#, #t1112429#.
QuestInfo.2: You have finally achieved Lv. 50. You are now strong enough to overcome all obstacles alone!

0.0: You've come so far! It's really great to watch you develop as you complete each mission. Now, the next step is Lv. 50. If you reach this level, you will receive an incredible ring. From what I've seen, I know you'll reach Lv. 50 in no time.

no.0: You've come so far...only to quit now? Please reconsider.

1.0: You've finally reached Lv. 50. Congratulations! Here, I'll give you a ring to signify your greatness as an Explorer!

yes.0: You've so drastically improved that I can hardly recognize you! I think you're strong enough now that you don't need to rely on my aid. Please continue your adventures in Maple World. I hope that my gifts will be put to good use. And don't forget that you and all the other Explorers are the true heroes of MapleStory!
